reason: My inbox is my to-do list and it basically works; I star things and live in Gmail all day. I'm not moving my whole business into a new app on a scroll-by, and if I tried anything it'd be the free plan, not $12 a month.
objection: All-in-one apps end up mediocre at everything, and I'd still keep my real email client open, so this just becomes one more app to check instead of replacing four.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work inside my existing Gmail flow, so starring an email or replying automatically lands the follow-up on the right client without me switching apps, and a friend freelancer saying it actually stopped them dropping follow-ups.
